card.name: Just before "immunodeficiency" in HIV text
card.fires_on: The word just before "immunodeficiency" or "immune", mainly "Human" in "Human Immunodeficiency Virus" and "in" before "acquired immune deficiency". It also fires weakly on a few odd spots such as a space in a lymphocyte count.

modes.label: Human before immunodeficiency
modes.description: The word "human" or the start of HUMAN right before "immunodeficiency virus".

modes.label: Lead-in to immune deficiency
modes.description: A linking word before "acquired immune deficiency" in an indication line.
modes.example: CMV RETINITIS<< IN>> PATIENTS WITH ACQUIRED IMMUN

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "imm" as the next piece, as in "immunodeficiency" or "immune".
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "immunodeficiency", mostly the "Human" in HIV.
